title: P1 campaign.control: request
description: A button on a campaign card from the channel on behalf of the person who pressed it: pause, resume, skip(n), cancel, retry_failed with the card nonce. resume and skip are decisions: only a human principal from the card's chat accepts them, not the initiator when self_approve: false, and on a production tenant never the initiator (APR-4, APR-9, ORC-2). Who pressed and from which chat, the channel passes in the headers Botaru-On-Behalf and Botaru-Chat by the on-behalf schema (spec/bindings/http/README.md); the body has no such fields.
